method: Complete bare footer, noon, live motion, native ANGLE/D3D11; three interleaved pairs per viewport; fresh contexts in one browser process; 24 actually drawn callbacks each. GPU EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 covers submitted GL work, not later compositor/presentation or retained-buffer copies. Only owned GPU jobs were quiet; concurrent CPU work and other PC apps uncontrolled. Viewport emulation is not physical phone performance.
